length_controlled_note: Pooled word-count-only AUC is 0.9010, which looks damning, but that is driven by between-bin base rates (median 12 words for Normal vs 88 for distress). WITHIN length quintiles the model holds AUC 0.9503/0.9560/0.9448/0.9195/0.9128 while length-only collapses to 0.6086/0.6279/0.6163/0.5895/0.5568. n-weighted within-bin model AUC = 0.9370, so the confound is worth 0.026, not 0.90. The lexical signal is real.
